build_int2bits_conversion: build a python module to convert integer tensors into binary bit representations using int2bits
build_bits2int_conversion: build a python module to convert binary bit tensors back into integer values using bits2int
create_analog_bits_manifold: create an AnalogBits manifold instance with a scale parameter for representing integers in analog euclidean space
create_multi_atom_analog_bits: create a MultiAtomAnalogBits manifold with scale num_bits num_atoms and max_num_atoms for masked atom representations
test_int_to_analog_bits_roundtrip: test the int_to_analog_bits and analog_bits_to_int functions to verify roundtrip conversion of atom types
